name: CONTROL
source:
“I’ve got to take back control. Over my life. Over my thoughts. Over my body. I don’t care what it takes. I don’t care how much it will tear me apart. I need this. And I won’t let anyone else have it”

[From [url=https://fernsensei.itch.io/control-toxic-yuri]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我必须夺回控制权。夺回对我的人生、我的思想、我的身体的控制。无论要付出怎样的代价，无论这会将我撕扯得如何支离破碎，我都不在乎。我需要这一切，而且绝不会让给其他任何人。”

[摘自[url=https://fernsensei.itch.io/control-toxic-yuri]itch.io[/url]]
